name: @veil-reputation-protocol/contract
description: Internal workspace package: Compact contract source + compiled artifacts for Veil Protocol v2. Never published to npm — @veil-reputation-protocol/sdk vendors the compiled contract + witness directly (see packages/sdk/src/vendor). Consumed inside this monorepo only, by backend and cli via workspace:*.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/managed && cp -Rf ./src/managed/veil-protocol ./dist/managed/veil-protocol && cp ./src/main.compact ./dist && cp -Rf ./src/modules ./dist
